# External Guidance Instructions

## Core Rules

- This file is the canonical owner of repository-wide external evidence, freshness, and source-routing policy. Prompts, workflow pages, and agent specs may link to it or add owner-specific deltas, but should not restate its policy body.
- Verify repository-local facts from workspace files before replying or editing. A user mentioning a file, asset, setting, or command does not prove that it exists in this repository.
- Search external sources before answering or editing when the task depends on current dates, versions, policies, package releases, vendor features, or other time-sensitive facts. Use exact dates when relative dates could confuse release or support guidance.
- Prefer source order: workspace evidence -> repository-connected tools -> official vendor docs or other primary sources -> general web corroboration only when needed.
- Separate verified repository facts from adaptation inferences when importing ideas from outside prompts, articles, or policies.
- Paraphrase external material in original words. Quote only when exact wording matters, and keep citations attached to the claims that depend on those sources.
- Do not copy vendor identity text, product catalogs, proprietary tags, tool schemas, or runtime-path assumptions into durable repository guidance unless this repository independently owns and verifies them.

## Detailed Workflow

- When the task is to adapt an external prompt, article, policy, or workflow, use `docs/ai-agents/workflow/external-guidance-adaptation.md`.
